mapper.select: SELECT b.instance_id, d.identify_state, f.dict_note AS identifyStateName, b.end_time, d.picpath, e.instance_name FROM ( (t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_attr e ON a.instance_id=e.instance_id) LEFT JOIN ( t_cruise_task_result_detail b LEFT JOIN (t_cruise_data_result d left JOIN t_dict_business f ON d.identify_state=f.dict_code AND f.col_name="identify_state") ON b.cruise_result_id = d.cruise_result_id ) ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result c ON b.task_result_id = c.task_result_id WHERE a.device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY b.end_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.end_time, c.instance_name, g.c_type, i.dict_note AS cTypeName, b.cruise_type, h.dict_note AS cruiseTypeName, f.identify_state, j.dict_note AS identifyStateName, f.result_num, f.picpath FROM ( t_std_devicemete a LEFT JOIN ( (t_cruise_point_instance b LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h ON b.cruise_type=h.dict_code AND h.col_name="cruise_type") LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_attr c ON b.instance_id = c.instance_id ) ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id ) LEFT JOIN ( ( ( t_cruise_task_result d LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e ON d.task_result_id = e.task_result_id ) LEFT JOIN (t_cruise_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_dict_business j ON f.identify_state=j.dict_code AND j.col_name="identify_state") ON e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id ) LEFT JOIN (t_cruise_result g LEFT JOIN t_dict_business i ON g.c_type=i.dict_code AND i.col_name="plan_type") ON d.task_result_id=g.task_result_id )ON b.instance_id=e.instance_id WHERE a.device_mete_id= #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY e.end_time DESC
